scenario.title: Transcripts to an external LLM analytics vendor
scenario.recipient: Cloud AI vendor (processor, outside the EU possible)
scenario.purpose: Topic mining, contact-reason trends and agent-quality insights on all channels.
scenario.threat_model: Vendor staff and model logs see all text; insider can link with leaked_customer_list.csv (public) or breach dumps (private evaluation).
scenario.legal_context: Processor under GDPR Art. 28; transfer safeguards if outside EEA. Pseudonymised text is still personal data; aim for no direct identifiers and no special-category data in text.
scenario.suggested_privacy_targets: No residual direct identifiers in text (recall ≥ 0.98 on NATIONAL_ID, PAYMENT_CARD, IBAN, SECRET); remove HEALTH mentions; consistent pseudonyms within a conversation; round timestamps to the hour.
scenario.notes: Keep the intent signal: do not delete whole utterances.

linkage.note: no attack spec targets this table (metadata/attack_specs.json)

utility.description: Intent classifier (TF-IDF + logistic regression) trained on protected train text, tested on original eval text.

utility.metric: mean handle time by intent, MAPE (0.5 → score 0)

utility.description: Ordinary vocabulary retained in text (redaction should remove identifiers, not meaning).

summary.label: self-assessment, not the official judging score
summary.method: privacy = 1 - (0.5*worst + 0.5*mean risk); utility = mean task score (required unanswerable = 0); composite = weighted harmonic mean (privacy 30, utility 25)
